purpose: 真实气象观测背景上的预注册模拟攻击安全运行点最终锁定流；V6 使用未见攻击参数组合、独立随机流和主 FAR=0.0065，不代表真实生产攻击日志。
multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg over provider x attack scenario comparisons

attack_generation_rules.train: normal observations only; no attack injection
attack_generation_rules.valid: scenario blocks injected with the frozen V2 generator; valid labels may select only the frozen candidate rule and FAR threshold
attack_generation_rules.test: scenario blocks injected with an independent V2 seed stream; test labels are evaluation-only
attack_generation_rules.delay: value replayed from a fixed four-row lag; it is a delayed measurement, not a timestamp edit
attack_generation_rules.drop_replay: a dropped packet is represented by an old-value hold while observation_present remains true; this avoids giving every method a free missingness label
attack_generation_rules.coordinated: two stations receive the same attack start and scenario, selected deterministically from the frozen station order
attack_generation_rules.unseen_boundary: delay/drop-replay are new attack families relative to V1; V1 parameters are not reused for selection

method_freeze.threshold_rule: valid normal rows only at FAR=0.01
method_freeze.selection_rule: no test labels, no test threshold selection, no attack-specific test tuning
method_freeze.v4_selection_rule: valid only; retain at least 95% of trust_only validation F1, maximize validation event coverage, tie by F1; test labels forbidden
method_freeze.v5_budget_rule: trust 50%, EWMA 25%, ARIMA 25% of primary FAR; valid-only candidate selection; test labels forbidden
method_freeze.v6_budget_rule: trust 50%, EWMA 25%, ARIMA 25% of primary FAR; valid-only selection; test labels forbidden

claim_boundary: This package supports only simulated/controlled attack claims.
V4 is a new attack-parameter and random-stream lock on the same four providers.
All baseline wins and failures remain reportable.

ensemble_freeze.selection: valid only; retain at least 95% of trust_valid_f1 validation F1, then maximize validation event coverage, then F1; test labels forbidden
